title: Fix Crashing Zoho API Too Many Requests Error Instantly #Shorts
description:
Learn how to fix Zoho CRM API TOO_MANY_REQUESTS errors by batching records, using COQL queries, and leveraging Bulk Read APIs.

1. Refactor your payload to batch 100 records per insert instead of sending single API calls.
2. Replace multiple GET requests with a single COQL (Zoho CRM Object Query Language) query.
3. Utilize the Bulk Read API for heavy data exports to bypass concurrency caps.

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho CRM V6 API
- endpoint: POST /crm/v6/{module}
- scope: ZohoCRM.modules.ALL
- docs: Zoho CRM API Limits and Concurrency

Code (json) - Your API client or script payload:
{
  "data": [
    {"Company": "Al Noor Trading", "Last_Name": "Smith"},
    {"Company": "Berlin Logistics GmbH", "Last_Name": "Muller"}
  ]
}

story.title: Integration suddenly fails with TOO_MANY_REQUESTS
story.summary: pillar: dev_api | product: Zoho CRM API | fix: Understand API credits and concurrency: batch 100 records per insert, use COQL instead of many GETs, Bulk Read for exports | facts: Credits per 24h: Free 5,000; Standard 50,000+250/user; Professional 50,000+500/user; Enterprise 50,000+1,000/user; Ultimate 50,000+2,000/user. Concurrency: Std 50, Pro 100, Ent 200, Ult 300, sub-concurrency 20. Insert/Update/Upsert = 1 credit per 10 records; COQL LIMIT<=200 = 1 credit; Bulk Read init 50; Bulk Write init 500. Deluge integration tasks use the same credits.
